name: Premier Umalas 16 — 3BR Pool Townhouse for Sale in Umalas
description: A three-bedroom pool townhouse in the quiet lanes of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, finished in dark stone and warm wood. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom and a desk by the window; the enclosed living room and the kitchen with its island are air-conditioned, and glass doors open onto a private pool and a small planted courtyard. The house is already in our rental programme, so the buyer takes over a property with a running booking history.
